title: The Price of an Explanation: What Demanding Verifiable Artifacts Costs, and What It Buys Back
title_zh: 解释的代价：要求可验证产物会失去什么，又能换回什么？
abstract_en: Generative models produce many candidate solutions but provide no intrinsic signal by which to rank them. One mitigation is to demand a \emph{verifiable artifact}: a program that can be executed against the available evidence. A common concern is that requiring executable verification incurs costs in both solution quality and computational budget. We measure these two costs on the $120$-task ARC-AGI-2 evaluation set. Demanding a verifiable artifact from an LLM reduced the score from $93$ to $68$ of $120$ tasks ($77\%$ to $57\%$). Of those $25$ tasks, $21$ were reached by no program-producing configuration we ran, at any budget, by sampling or by search; yet for $27$ of the $28$ tasks that only the answer-only arm solved, some program arm held a program that reproduced every demonstration and still failed the test. The bottleneck is obtaining an explanation that \emph{generalizes}, not finding one. A short evolutionary search over two already-sampled programs, at no additional model cost, beats best-of-$2$ sampled code by $9.2 \pm 1.4$ tasks, and over a single sampled program beats $1$-shot sampling by $9.9 \pm 1.3$. Moreover, because a program can be checked against the training examples, any program-producing protocol can terminate early once a task is explained: under the same stopping rule, best-of-$n$ sampling declines up to $38\%$ of its budget and the evolved arm up to $49\%$, whereas an answer-only baseline cannot terminate early. Applying the same methodology to decoder synthesis for quantum error correction yields interpretable decoders evaluated against a certified panel of published decoders on held-out exam shots.
abstract_zh: 生成模型能提出多个候选解，却缺乏内在的排序信号。一种做法是要求模型输出可验证产物（verifiable artifact），即能在现有示例上运行并接受检验的程序。作者在 ARC-AGI-2 的 120 道评测任务上衡量了这一要求对解题表现和计算预算的影响。要求 LLM 输出程序后，解题数从 93 道降至 68 道（77% 降至 57%）。但在仅输出答案的方案独自解出的 28 道题中，有 27 道至少存在一个能复现全部示例、却仍在测试中失败的程序。这表明瓶颈不是找到符合示例的解释，而是找到能泛化的解释。对已采样的程序进行短程进化搜索，无需额外调用模型，即可提高解题数。程序还允许在通过全部训练示例后提前停止：在相同停止规则下，从 n 个样本中择优的方案最多节省 38% 的预算，进化搜索方案最多节省 49%，而仅输出答案的基线无法据此提前停止。作者还将该方法用于量子纠错的解码器合成，在留出的测试测量样本上，将所得的可解释解码器与一组经认证的已发表解码器进行比较。
key_points_zh: 在 ARC-AGI-2 上，要求输出程序使解题数从 93/120 降至 68/120；两者相差的 25 道题中，有 21 道在实验覆盖的所有预算和程序生成配置下均未解出。
仅输出答案的方案独自解出的 28 道题中，有 27 道存在通过全部示例却未通过测试的程序：示例验证不能保证泛化。
不增加模型调用时，从两个已采样程序出发进行进化搜索，比从两个样本中择优（best-of-2）多解 9.2 ± 1.4 道题；从单个程序出发则比单次采样多解 9.9 ± 1.3 道题。
以通过全部训练示例为停止条件，从 n 个样本中择优（best-of-n）最多节省 38% 的预算，进化搜索最多节省 49%；仅输出答案的基线无法使用这一停止条件。
